payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes: gtools-vc is compacting, so every START comes to utilz-vc again, by SendMessage, slots from 97, on decisions 59 and 62's terms. The Mac stays closed to heavy runs until the Gtools 0.6.0 cut's step 5 ends. Light runs and kovacs legs can go until Gtools' dispatch run goes green; from then until step 5 ends nothing starts, kovacs legs included, since kovacs loads this Mac. Say light or heavy in every START.
